title.target: I see what you mean, but...
title.es: Estar de acuerdo y discrepar con educación

objective: Al terminar expresas acuerdo y desacuerdo con distintos grados de educación y matices, y respondes a opiniones ajenas.

warmup.prompt_es: No es lo mismo decir 'estoy en desacuerdo' que 'no estoy del todo seguro'. Elegir el nivel de acuerdo adecuado mejora mucho la comunicación.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: I think people spend too much time on their phones. It's ruining our relationships.
lines.es: Creo que la gente pasa demasiado tiempo con el móvil. Está arruinando nuestras relaciones.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.text: I couldn't agree more. At dinner nobody talks any more.
lines.es: Totalmente de acuerdo. En la cena ya nadie habla.

lines.speaker: Cleo
lines.text: I see what you mean, but I'm not sure that's entirely true. My phone helps me stay in touch with my family abroad.
lines.es: Entiendo lo que quieres decir, pero no estoy segura de que sea del todo cierto. Mi móvil me ayuda a mantener contacto con mi familia en el extranjero.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: That's a fair point. I suppose it depends on how you use it.
lines.es: Es un buen punto. Supongo que depende de cómo se use.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.text: Exactly. Still, I don't agree that it's always positive. Face-to-face conversation is more meaningful.
lines.es: Exacto. Aun así, no estoy de acuerdo en que siempre sea positivo. La conversación cara a cara es más significativa.

lines.speaker: Cleo
lines.text: I'm afraid I disagree. It depends on the people. Some conversations online are very deep.
lines.es: Me temo que no estoy de acuerdo. Depende de la gente. Algunas conversaciones por internet son muy profundas.

lines.speaker: Ada
lines.text: Well, maybe we can agree to disagree. The important thing is to find a balance.
lines.es: Bueno, quizá podamos aceptar que no coincidimos. Lo importante es encontrar un equilibrio.

lines.speaker: Bruno
lines.text: Agreed. Let's put our phones away and enjoy the evening.
lines.es: De acuerdo. Guardemos los móviles y disfrutemos de la velada.

md_es: **Acuerdo y desacuerdo: de más a menos**
| **Total** | *I completely agree. · I couldn't agree more. · Exactly! · Absolutely.* | *I completely disagree. · That's not true at all.* |
| **Fuerte** | *I agree with you. · You're right.* | *I don't agree. · I disagree.* |
| **Parcial** | *I see what you mean, but … · That's a fair point, but … · Up to a point.* | *I'm not sure about that. · I'm afraid I disagree. · I'm not so sure.* |
| **Neutral** | *It depends. · I suppose so. · Maybe.* | *We'll have to agree to disagree.* |
1. Reconoce lo que dijo el otro: *I see what you mean, …*
3. Usa *I'm afraid* o *I'm not sure* para cortesía.
4. Justifica con una razón o ejemplo.
- *I (don't) think (that) + cláusula* — pero para negar una opinión, se niega *think*: *I don't think it's true.* (no *I think it isn't true*)
- *I agree / disagree with + persona*; *I agree that + cláusula.*
- *I'm afraid I can't agree.* · *Don't you think that …?*

**Ojo:** ✘ *I am agree.* ✔ *I agree.* ✘ *I'm in disagree* ✔ *I disagree.* *Argue* = discutir con enfado; *discuss* = debatir con respeto. *Opinion* ≠ *opinion polls*. *Fair* puede significar 'justo' o 'razonable'.

exercises.prompt: Escribe (6 a 8 frases) una conversación breve o párrafo en el que expreses acuerdo parcial y desacuerdo educado sobre este tema: 'Online friends are as real as face-to-face friends'.
self_check_es: ¿Usas I don't think / I'm not sure?
exercises.model_answer: I see what you mean, but I'm not sure online friends are as real as face-to-face friends. It's true that you can share ideas and support each other. However, I don't think it's the same as spending time together in person. On the other hand, some people may feel less alone thanks to online friends. I agree that the quality of the relationship matters more than the way you meet. Maybe we can agree to disagree.
